description: 3 should-trigger + 3 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers packing a repo into one LLM-ready file, packing a remote library with a token count, and a German phrasing. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours (reading two specific files, converting a PDF to text) plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: pack this repository into a single AI-friendly file for an LLM review
package the remote library as XML with a token count, without cloning it
pack das Repo in eine einzige Datei für die LLM-Analyse
show me these two files so I can read them
queries.note: a few specific files are read directly, not packaged

queries.q: convert this PDF report to markdown
